lines.speaker: mei
lines.text: You're finally here. The wind is strong tonight.

lines.speaker: chen
lines.text: I can see it - the clouds are drifting toward the shore.

lines.speaker: mei
lines.text: Want to come with me? Or would you rather look around on your own?

lines.speaker: chen
lines.text: Then let's go, before it gets dark.

lines.speaker: chen
lines.text: Alright - I'll head over to the lighthouse.
